This endpoint returns the public and private SSH key that Pipelines uses to authenticate and access external resources during build and deployment processes. The key pair enables secure connections to remote servers, allowing pipelines to perform operations like deploying code or accessing private dependencies. items.docs: This API operation deletes the configured SSH key pair associated with a specific Bitbucket Pipelines configuration for a repository. By sending a DELETE request to this endpoint with the workspace identifier and repository slug, administrators can remove the SSH key pair that was previously set up for secure authentication during pipeline executions.
